Neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã la b gɩdg nebã n yi Wẽnd sorã, A sãama bãmb tʋʋma.
La neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩd la b tʋm sõma, la b kõ sɩd ne bũmb ning sẽn sik a Mʋhammad zugã (yẽ me la sɩda n yi bãmb Soabã nengẽ) A yẽesa bãmb yel-beed n yi-ba, la A maneg b yεla.
Yaa woto bala, tɩ neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã, b pʋga zĩri, la neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩdã, b pʋga sɩd sẽn yi b Soabã nengẽ; yaa woto bal la Wẽnd wilgd nebã, b tɑɑbã bilg-n-taare.

Yãmb sã n wa yek neb nins sẽn kɩfl-ba (zabrẽ), yaa yubli keeb bala, hal tɩ yãmb sã n wa koms-ba, bɩ y keng sẽbrã maa tɩ y bas taale, maa tɩ y reeg yõor yaoodo, hal tɩ zabrã wa tɩ rɩgl a zɩɩbo. Yaa woto bala, la Wẽnd sã n rag n tʋlla, A naan n halk-ba, la yaa sẽn na yɩl n zarb yãmb ne taab n gese. Neb nins b sẽn kʋ Wẽnd Sorã zugã, A kõn n yeeb b tʋʋm lae-lae ye.
A na n peeg-b lame la A maneg b yεla.
La A kẽes-b arzãna, A sẽn rag n sɩf-ɑ wilg-b dũni wã.
Yãmb ɑ neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde! Y sã n sõng Wẽnde, A sõngd-y lame, la A tabl y nao-kadma.
La neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã, yaalg be ne-ba, la A sãɑm b tʋʋmã.
Yaa woto bala, tɩ ad bãmb kisga Wẽnd sẽn sik bũmb ningã t'A lub bãmb tʋʋmã.
Rẽ yĩnga bãmb pa kẽnd Tẽngã zug n get wãn-wãn la neb nins sẽn reng bãmb taoorã baasg yɩ yã? Wẽnd pama b zugu, rẽnda buud n be ne kɩfr-dãmba.
Yaa woto bala, tɩ yaa Wẽnd la neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã Lall-n-taaga, la neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã, bãmb pa tar lalld ye.
Wẽnd kẽesda neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã la b tʋm sõama wã arzãn-rãmbẽ, ko-sood sẽn zoet b tẽngre, la neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã wʋmda noog la b rɩtẽ wala rũmsã sẽn rɩtã, la Bugmã la bãmb gãag zĩiga.
La sõor waoog tẽng sẽn yɩɩd fo tẽng ning sẽn yiis foo wã ne keelem, lɑ Tõnd yaool n halk-b lɑme, tɩ sõngd pa be ne-b ye.
Rẽ yĩnga, ned ning sẽn be vẽenem zugu, sẽn yi a Soabã nengẽ, wõndɑ wala ned ning b sẽn faas a tʋʋm-wẽng t'ɑ ne-ɑ t'ɑ yɑɑ neere, la b pʋg b yõe yamleoodo?.

Arzãn ning b sẽn pʋlem ne Wẽnd zoεtbã bilgri: ko-sood n be a pʋgẽ sẽn yaa koom sẽn pa tedgde, la ko-sood sẽn yaa bĩisim, a noosmã pa tedgd ye; la ko-sood sẽn yaa noosem yũudbã yĩnga, la ko-sood sẽn yaa sɩɩd sẽn yɩlge. La b leb n tar a pʋgẽ tɩ-biisã fãa gilli, la yaafa sẽn yi b Soabã nengẽ. Rẽ yĩnga, wã na yɩ wala neb nins sẽn duumd Bugmã pʋgẽ tɩ b yũnug-b ko-tʋʋlg t'a fãs b yãadã?

La be b (kɩfr-dãmbã) pʋgẽ, ned ning sẽn kelgd foom hal tɩ b sã n wa yi fo nengẽ la b sẽn yet neb nins b sẽn kõ bãngrã: "yaa bõe la a sẽn da yet moas-moasã wã? "Bãmb la neb nins Wẽnd sẽn pag b sũyã tɩ b pʋgd b yamleoodo.
La neb nins sẽn kãndgã, A paasa bãmb kãndgr la A kõ-b b wẽn-zoεεgã.
La rẽ yĩnga, bãmbã gũuda bũmb tɩ sã n pa dũni wã yikr sẽn na n wa b nengẽ ne lingri. La sɩd la hakɩɩka, a tagmas-rãmbã zoe n waame. La bãmbã na n yɩɩ wãn n tẽeg t'a sã n wa wa bãmb (ne lingri)?
Bɩ f bãng ne hakɩɩk tɩ soab kae tɩ sã n pa Wẽnd ye. La f kos yaafa f zũunuubã yĩnga, la muumin roapã la muumin pogsã me zũunuub yĩnga. Lɑ Wẽnd mii yãmb lεbeng zĩiga, la yãmb gãag zĩiga.

La neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã yetame: "b pa na n sik Sʋʋra?" Tɩ b sã n yaool n sik sʋʋra sẽn bʋ n manege, n tẽeg zabr a pʋgẽ fo yãta neb nins bãag sẽn be b rãmb sũyẽ wã tɩ b get foo wala ned sẽn sobg kũum rebeem keelem gesgo, lɑ sẽn sõmba ne-ba.
Tũudum la gomd sẽn be neere n da sõmb ne bãmba. La yellã sã n wa loe n wãag bɩ f bãng tɩ bãmb sã n da kõẽ Wẽnd sɩda na yɩẽ sõma ne-ba.
La rẽ yĩnga y pa yaeesd tɩ y sã n gũd kuidga, yaa sãang bal la y na n sãeeg Tẽngã zug la y wãag rogem, wɑlɑ y sẽn n dɑ mɑɑn zɩɩlemã sɑsɑ wã?
Sẽn mɑɑnd-b rẽ wã bãmbɑ lɑ Wẽnd sẽn kãabã, n wʋng-ba tɩ b kɑ wʋmd sɩd ye, la A zong b ninã.
Rẽ yĩnga bãmb pa tagsd Alkʋrãanã n getẽ, bɩ yaa kʋɩlem-biis n be b sũyẽ wã?
Ad neb nins sẽn tar n lebg poorẽ kãndgrã sẽn vẽneg ne bãmb poorã, yaa a Sʋɩtãan n liib-ba la a walem-ba.
Yaa woto tɩ bãmb yeela neb nins sẽn kisg bũmb ning Wẽnd sẽn sikã: "d na n pʋg-y-la yel-sãnda pʋgẽ". La Wẽnd mii b solgrã.
La na n yɩɩ wãn-wãn tɩ Malεgsã sã n wa kʋʋd bãmba, n pãbd bãmb nensã, la b poayã?
Yɩta woto tɩ bala bãmb tũu bũmb ning sẽn gẽed Wẽndã, la b kisg A yardã t'A lub bãmb tʋʋmã.
Bɩ neb nins bãag sẽn be b rãmb sũyẽ wã tẽedame tɩ Wẽnd pa na n tol n mɑɑn tɩ bãmb beemɑ lɑ b kisgrã yi n vẽneg tɩ nebɑ bãng-bɑ.
La Tõnd sã n da tʋlla, M naan n wilg-f-ba. La fo na bãng-b ne b tagmas-rãmbã, fo na bãng-b neer-neer b gom bɩndmã pʋgẽ. La Wẽnd mii yãmb tʋʋmã.
La Tõnd na zarb yãmb neer-neere, hal n wa bãng nidg pãng rãmb Wẽnd Sorã zugu, la sugr rãmba, la D zɑrb yãmb n ges n mɑɑn tɩ b bãng yãmb sɩd soɑbɑ lɑ y zĩri-be-nedɑ.
Ad neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã la b gɩd Wẽnd Sorã la b maan Tẽn-tʋʋmã beem kãndgrã sẽn vẽneg ne bãmb poorẽ, b kõn n tol n nams Wẽnd baa fʋɩ, A na n luba b tʋʋmã me.
Yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde! Tũ-y Wẽnde, la y tũ Tẽn-tʋʋmã la y ra sãam y tʋʋm ye.
Sɩd la hakɩɩka, neb nins sẽn kɩfl-b la b gɩd Wẽnd Sorã, rẽ poorẽ tɩ b ki tɩ b kell n yaa kɩfr-dãmbã, Wẽnd kõn n tol n yaaf-b ye.
Bɩ y ra valems ye, la y ra baood laafɩ rabeem yĩng ye, tɩ yãmb n yaool n be zugẽ. Wẽnd bee ne yãmba, A kõn n tol n boog yãmb tʋʋmã me.
Ad Dũni wã vɩɩmã yaa wɩsg la reem. La yãmb sã n kõ sɩd la y zoe Wẽnde, A kõta yãmb y keoorã, la A pa modgd yãmb y arzεkẽ wã ye.
A sã n modgd yãmb a pʋgẽ n pẽdg yãmba, y maanda beed la A yiis yãmb kisgrã.

Ad yãmba, b boonda yãmb tɩ y yãk n naf Wẽnd Sorã zugu. La bee yãmb pʋgẽ sẽn maand beedo. La ned ning sẽn maanda beedo, ad a maand a meng beedo. Wẽnd yaa Sek-m-meng Soaba, yãmb la tʋlsdba. Y sã n gũd y kuidga, A tedgda yãmb ne zẽms sẽn pa yãmba, rẽ poorẽ b pa yɩt wala yãmb buud ye.
